## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Moderate (3/5 across Industrials, Healthcare, Materials); confirmation: strong sector breadth and cyclical leadership alongside concentrated tech weakness and a major divergence among mega-caps (multiple large-cap techs BELOW TREND), supporting a cautious stance.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Industrials lead: FDX ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.58% | 1M: +20.14%), MMM ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.73% | 1M: +5.98%), UPS ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.47% | 1M: +11.32%). Energy strong: XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +25.79%), VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.40% | 1M: +10.91%), CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +16.53%). Consumer Staples firm: PEP ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +24.44%), WMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +16.38%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology is lagging: Tech composite 1W: -4.39% with many large caps BELOW TREND (e.g., MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -17.03%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -2.99% | 1M: -1.96%)). Consumer Discretionary weak: AMZN BELOW TREND (1W: -12.11% | 1M: -12.93%), BKNG BELOW TREND (1W: -10.89% | 1M: -18.15%). Financials show dispersion and relative lag vs top cyclicals with notable outlier weakness in PYPL BELOW TREND (1W: -23.29% | 1M: -30.92%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.35% | 1M: +28.15%), FDX ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.58% | 1M: +20.14%), MMM ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.73% | 1M: +5.98%), BMY ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.61% | 1M: +9.29%), AMGN ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.41% | 1M: +12.49%). Leadership: Moderate (3/5 across Industrials, Healthcare, Materials) — cyclical/capital goods and healthcare are driving the move.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: QCOM BELOW TREND (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -23.78%), CRM BELOW TREND (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -28.10%), BKNG BELOW TREND (1W: -10.89% | 1M: -18.15%), INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -11.05% | 1M: -31.72%), AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -11.95% | 1M: -0.75%). Weakness concentrated in high-multiple Technology names, amplifying regime caution.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W momentum: DOW (1W: +15.35%), FDX (1W: +14.58%), MMM (1W: +12.73%), BMY (1W: +12.61%), AMGN (1W: +12.41%). Note major divergence: several large-tech names show 1W vs 1M mismatch (GOOGL, META CORRECTION; JPM, V, MA RECOVERY), signaling tactical dispersion rather than uniform trend.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is under pressure with broad downside: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -2.99% | 1M: -1.96%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -17.03%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -25.74%), while AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.18% | 1M: +6.83%) is a notable outlier; Tech breadth is weak relative to the market. Sector posture: CORRECTION concentration among mega-caps and earnings/estimate risk.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials show mixed strength with pockets of recovery: JPM RECOVERY (1W: +5.40% | 1M: -1.40%), V RECOVERY (1W: +3.03% | 1M: -6.83%), MA RECOVERY (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -5.23%) versus PYPL BELOW TREND (1W: -23.29% | 1M: -30.92%). Sector action supports a Value/Cyclical style tilt given cyclicals (CAT, XOM) and bank reversals.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare constructive: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.61% | 1M: +15.66%), MRK ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.57% | 1M: +12.27%), PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.95% | 1M: +9.48%), with several large-cap biopharma also rallying. Sector breadth looks positive and is providing defensive yet growth-adjacent leadership within the current rotation.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor cyclicals and defensive/cash-generative names within Industrials, Energy and select Healthcare (e.g., CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.47% | 1M: +22.02%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +25.79%), JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.61% | 1M: +15.66%)). Reduce exposure to stretched/uncertain Tech names showing consistent BELOW TREND patterns (e.g., CRM, ORCL, NOW). Maintain nimble positioning due to CAUTION regime and large-cap divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.35% | 1M: +28.15%), FDX ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.58% | 1M: +20.14%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +25.79%) — watch follow-through on momentum. BEARISH: ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -25.74%), NOW BELOW TREND (1W: -13.90% | 1M: -33.24%), QCOM BELOW TREND (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -23.78%) — downside continuation risk if sector flows remain negative.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Industrials (13 stocks in sector; heavy 1W gains) and Energy (8 stocks; strong earnings/flows) as leaders to monitor for spillover. BEARISH: Technology (19 stocks; 1W: -4.39% | 1M: -6.62%) and Consumer Discretionary showing downside in major constituents.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch regime/label flips rather than absolute prices: NVDA moving back to 1W>0% and 1M>0% would shift it off BELOW TREND into RECOVERY/CORRECTION testing; AAPL holding recent gains to remain ABOVE TREND is supportive for Tech sentiment; JPM sustaining 1W strength into a positive 1M would convert RECOVERY into ABOVE TREND and confirm financials’ leadership. Monitor ORCL/NOW for continued distribution on further 1W weakness.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
VLO (+55): VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.40% | 1M: +10.91%) — Q4 beat/dividend increase sentiment confirming price action. SLB (+65): sentiment positive on a large contract win; watch for follow-through (price action to confirm). SPG (+60): buyback/board actions have bullish lift; monitor price for confirmation vs sector.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
ORCL (-50): ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -25.74%) — price confirms downgrade-driven negative bias. NOW (-50): NOW BELOW TREND (1W: -13.90% | 1M: -33.24%) — Truist cut aligns with heavy selling. UNH (-60): UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -3.58% | 1M: -19.04%) — regulatory probe headlines are confirming downside risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with a Value/Cyclical tilt. Industrials and Energy showing relative strength (FDX ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.58% | 1M: +20.14%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.41% | 1M: +25.79%)). Key risk: concentrated Tech weakness and multi-stock divergences (CRM, ORCL, NOW BELOW TREND) alongside mixed news flows (UNH regulatory headlines) — monitor for trend confirmation.
